response.overview: The fastest way to get a response from Lufthansa  is to use the Live Chat or  you can reach them at +1 844 508 8282 (US) for nonstop access to their website and app for booking flights, hotels, and vacation packages. Also feature on the Lufthansa  Mobile App, which typically connects you with a +44 (808) 175  7375 (UK) live agent in 10–30 minutes. For immediate assistance, you can call their customer support line at +1 844 508 8282 .
